in_arabic.name: جمعات
in_arabic.meaning: جمعة يوم الجمعة يوم جميل جدا للمسلمين
in_arabic.long_meaning: جمعة تعني يوم الجمعة الذي هو يوم عيد للمسلمين، يوافق يوم الجمعة الذي يعتبر يوما مباركا في الإسلام، ويوم الجمعة هو يوم جميل جدا للمسلمين حيث يجتمعون فيه لأداء الصلاة والاحتفال

in_urdu.name: جمعات
in_urdu.meaning: جمعہ کا دن مسلموں کے لئے بہت اچھا دن ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: جمعہ کے دن کا مطلب ہے کہ مسلموں کے لئے یہ ایک مبارک دن ہے، جس دن وہ جمعہ کی نماز ادا کرتے ہیں اور اس دن کو ایک خاص اہمیت دیتے ہیں، اور اس دن کے فضائل بہت زیادہ ہیں

in_hindi.name: जुमात
in_hindi.meaning: जुमे का दिन मुसलमानों के लिए बहुत अच्छा दिन है
in_hindi.long_meaning: जुमे का दिन मुसलमानों के लिए एक विशेष दिन है जब वे जुमे की नमाज पढ़ते हैं और इस दिन को बहुत महत्व देते हैं, और इस दिन के बहुत सारे फजाइल हैं

in_pashto.name: جمعات
in_pashto.meaning: جمعې د مسلمانو لپاره ډیر ښه ورځ ده
in_pashto.long_meaning: جمعې د ورځې معنی دا ده چې د مسلمانو لپاره دا یو برکت لرونکی ورځ ده، په دې ورځ دوی جمعې لمونځ ادا کوي او دې ورځې ته ډیر اهمیت ورکوي، او دې ورځې ډیر فضایل لري

in_english.name: Jumaat
in_english.meaning: Friday, a day of congregation for Muslims
in_english.long_meaning: Jumaat, derived from the Arabic root 'جمع' (jama'a), meaning 'to gather' or 'to congregate', refers to Friday, a sacred day in Islam when Muslims gather for congregational prayer, considered a day of blessings and spiritual rejuvenation

data.cultural_impact: Jumu'ah, or Friday, is a significant day in the Islamic culture worldwide. It is the day when Muslims are encouraged to gather together in mosques or prayer areas to offer communal prayers, known as Jumu'ah or Jummah prayers. This gathering is not just a communal activity but also an opportunity for Muslims to learn, connect, and engage with their communities. In addition, the Jumu'ah prayer is considered a bargain between Muslims and Allah, where Muslims promise to worship Him and strive for His pleasure in return for His blessings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Jumu'ah is a day of deep reflection, introspection, and worship for Muslims. It is a time when they can connect with their faith, reflect on their spiritual growth, and seek Allah's guidance and forgiveness. The communal praying on Jumu'ah is an act of unification and solidarity among Muslims, as they come together to offer their prayers to Allah and seek His blessings. Furthermore, the Jumu'ah prayer is also an opportunity for Muslims to learn and be inspired by the khutbah (sermon), which is given by the imam (leader) and covers various aspects of Islamic teachings and contemporary issues. Ultimately, Jumu'ah is a day ofconnection, spiritual growth, and seeking Allah's pleasure and guidance for Muslims.
